plugins.name: harness-dev
plugins.description: Authoring aids for the Claude Code harness — skill shapes (workflow, loop, instruction, router) and repo bootstrap (README, CLAUDE.md, deploy and adr skills, settings).

plugins.name: hi
plugins.description: Per-session prompt stack: push/pop/list/drop prompts across a session.

plugins.name: self-improvement
plugins.description: Captures generalizable behavioral rules from user corrections on session end (Stop hook), writes each into a new or existing skill with the capture-lesson skill, and consolidates the accumulated skill corpus with the dream skill.

plugins.name: show
plugins.description: Show a markdown file in a native review window, wait for the reader's inline annotations, and act on them. /show reviews an existing file, /show:draft writes one from a prompt first.

plugins.name: smart-commit
plugins.description: Split the working tree of every nearby git repo into logical commits at hunk granularity. A sonnet subagent proposes the split into an editable file, the operator answers each block, a second subagent builds the commits in a throwaway worktree and cherry-picks them back.

plugins.name: vocab
plugins.description: In-memory topic index served over MCP: one topic points at the one file that carries its truth. Starts empty each session, never written to disk. A UserPromptSubmit hook loads the tools on the first message and reminds the agent every 15 minutes to file what it read.

plugins.name: wm
plugins.description: Work lifecycle management v2 — phased workflows (research, plan, implement) with agents, commands, and hooks.
